description: Returns the caller's identity, org, role, role-derived RBAC capabilities, and token scopes. Use this to check whether the current token may perform an action (e.g. config:write) before attempting it.
name: whoami

principalType.description: agent: a self-registered agent nobody has claimed yet. It has no user, org, role or scopes, and reaches only /me and /scopes until a person claims it.

projectId.description: The project this credential is bound to, or null when it is org-wide. A bound token can read and act only on that project, and on nothing org-wide - so a caller can see the boundary it works within rather than discovering it through a 404.

title: Identify the calling principal
